purpose: Allow an external Starfleet Academy study website/app to consume the same curriculum while remaining independent from gameplay runtime.
rules: External study profiles may be stored locally or exported/imported as JSON.
The player nickname may match the game profile to help identify which campaign context the user is studying for.
Game context shown by the web is informational and may be entered manually.
The web does not simulate passage through four Academy years and must not lock the curriculum by game progress.
No password is required by this contract; identity/security policy belongs to the consuming application.
External progress is not automatically authoritative in-game Academy state.
The future game may import validated study evidence only through an explicit import/verification path.
Curriculum IDs and versions must remain stable enough to migrate saved progress.
The external app should consume the same curriculum/content IDs used by the game whenever practical.
Access curriculum, Academy curriculum, PDF material and web presentation must not diverge into separate academic canons.
